responsibility: Implements the behavior of attribute-wrapping declarations after parsing. This file applies attribute scopes to enclosed declarations, forwards member/scope/import/field-offset/pointer queries through included members, creates adjusted `Scope` objects for linkage/storage/protection/alignment/inlining changes, and contains the concrete machinery for higher-level attribute constructs such as static foreach expansion, forwarding attribute declarations, mixin declarations, and user-defined attributes with evaluated attribute expressions.
same_name_distinction: Implements how attribute wrapper declarations actually propagate scope and enclosed members, including conditional/static-foreach/mixin/UDA behavior, whereas `attrib.h` mainly declares the many attribute declaration classes and their interfaces.
